meta.title: TeckHub360 — client portal for Canadian accounting firms
meta.description: A white-label client portal for Canadian accounting firms — document checklists, OCR-assisted GIFI coding, step-by-step filing for business and T1 clients, payroll with client approval, invoicing, deadlines and secure chat in one place.

hero.title: The portal Canadian accounting firms *run filing season on.*
hero.text: Clients send documents against a checklist, your team codes and files them, payroll and invoices sit beside the return — and everyone can see exactly where things stand.

audiences.title: One portal, *four kinds of user.*
audiences.text: TeckHub360 grew out of building portals for Canadian practices one at a time. Everyone involved in a return logs in to the same place — and sees only their part of it.

items.title: Your office
items.text: Admins, accountants and staff, each with the menus and actions their role allows — and a partner view of everything outstanding.

items.title: Business clients
items.text: Corporations, sole proprietors, partnerships and the self-employed upload, sign and approve from their own organisation.

items.title: Their employees
items.text: Staff see their own payslips and T4s. A trusted employee can load documents, held for the owner to approve first.

items.title: Individual filers
items.text: T1 clients complete a profile once, work through a checklist by category and follow their return to the end.

modules.title: Ten modules, *one login.*
modules.text: Everything a practice touches during filing season — rather than a document tool, a billing tool, a payroll spreadsheet and an inbox.

ocr.title: Documents in. GIFI codes suggested. *A human still signs off.*
paragraphs: Coding a shoebox of receipts is the least pleasant, most repetitive part of the job. TeckHub360 reads each uploaded PDF, pulls out the figures and matches them against the CRA's General Index of Financial Information.
Clients can also upload their profit & loss and balance sheet and have the rows extracted for you. The value is in removing the typing, not the judgement.

steps.title: Upload
steps.text: Receipts, invoices and statements arrive as PDFs against the checklist.

steps.title: Read
steps.text: Totals and line items are pulled out of the document text.

steps.title: Suggest
steps.text: A CRA GIFI code is proposed with a confidence score. Under 70% is flagged for a manual check.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.text: An accountant accepts or corrects every code before it reaches the code summary.

demoBand.title: Easier to show than to describe.
demoBand.text: Bring one of your own filing scenarios and we'll run it through the portal on the call.

pipelines.title: Two ordered paths, *so nothing gets filed out of sequence.*
pipelines.text: Each step works on what the one before it produced, and a partner can see where any client sits without asking the accountant handling it.

items.title: Prep Accounts
items.note: The client signs the return form inside the portal and follows it from “form generated” to “filed”.

items.title: Finalize Account
items.note: Filers get a review-only view of the same four steps, so they can confirm without being able to change the work.

payroll.title: Payroll your clients *actually sign off on.*
payroll.text: Payroll runs inside the same client record as the return, with the client in the loop at the point that matters — before anyone is paid.

items.title: Agreements & pay settings
items.text: A payroll agreement per client, pay settings per employee, dated pay changes and TD1 exemptions — with a history of every correction.

items.title: Any pay frequency
items.text: Weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, monthly, bi-monthly, quarterly or annual, set employee by employee.

items.title: Review, then approve
items.text: A five-step pay run: your accountant reviews it, the client approves it, nothing goes out on one person’s say-so.

items.title: QuickBooks payslip import
items.text: Bring existing payslip PDFs in from QuickBooks instead of re-keying them.

items.title: PD7A & T4 slips
items.text: Remittances and year-end slips tracked and stored against each client.

items.title: My Pay for employees
items.text: Employees log in to their own payslips and T4 history — and stop emailing the office for copies.

paperwork.title: Chasing paperwork, *without the chasing.*
paperwork.text: Clients work from a checklist rather than a reply-all thread, and your team sees every CRA date across the whole book — with guidance and links for each.

items.q: Does the OCR code documents on its own?
items.a: No, and that is deliberate. It reads the document, suggests a CRA GIFI code with a confidence score and flags anything under 70%. An accountant confirms every code before it reaches the code summary.

items.q: Does TeckHub360 e-file returns with the CRA?
items.a: No. Your team files through the CRA software it already uses, then marks the return filed in the portal — so the client and the partner can both see it is done.

items.q: Can we use our own branding?
items.a: Yes — logo, favicon, heading, body and button colours, typeface, and light or dark theme, all from settings.

items.q: Does it handle both businesses and individual filers?
items.a: Both: corporations, sole proprietors, partnerships and the self-employed alongside T1 filers, each with their own filing steps, invoice type and client view.
Payments are recorded against each invoice — E-Transfer, cheque, pre-authorized debit or cash — rather than taken by card through the portal.
